'''Essith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He desired a position that was instead taken by [[Arkos Rakton]], but after Rakton was captured by [[Havoc Squad]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], Essith was eventually able to obtain the position he believed himself to be deserving of. From then on, he became determined to succeed where his predecessor failed and become a champion of the Empire.<ref name="Nathema" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Death_of_General_Essith.jpg|thumb|left|General Essith is sacrificed to Zildrog.]]
General Essith appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint only if [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] is a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] who made the choice to ally with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[War on Iokath]]. In this case, Essith will seek to eliminate the [[Eternal Alliance]] and join the [[Order of Zildrog]] led by [[Vinn Atrius]], only to be sacrificed as fuel to awaken [[Zildrog]] by [[GEMINI 16]] on [[Nathema]]. If the player chooses to ally with the Sith Empire, General [[Elin Garza]] will appear instead of Essith, while the other classes face antagonists from their own class stories.<ref name="Nathema" />
